10.3.3 Sequence diagram for termination and restart of a partition
The sequence of events for terminating or restarting a partition is shown in Figure 4. The details are described in Section 10.3.2. sd TerminateRestartPartition Os-Application state for the considered Partition. RTE BSW modules OSRestartTask OS ProtectionHook APPLICATION_ACCESSIBLE For both Termination and Restart, the OS is requested to terminate the Os-Application and start the Os-Application's OSRestartTask. ProtectionHook Rte_PartitionTerminated_<Partition> / Rte_PartitionRestarting_<partition> PRO_TERMINATEAPPL_RESTART APPLICATION_RESTARTING opt ReInitExample APPLICATION_ACCESSIBLE ActivateTask opt CleanupExample CallTrustedFunction(cleanup_IO) Cleanup activities can be individually triggered from the OSRestartTask (note: CallTrustedFunction shall be used to switch to the BSW partition), or the RestartTask can trigger the BSW Mode Manager (BswM) which can be configured with an action list containing the cleanup activities (the BswM must also be triggered using CallTrustedFunction). The cleanup activities are project specific. This example contains synchronous and asynchronous activities. CallTrustedFunction(cleanupNVM) loop Polling [not CLEANUP_FINISHED] CallTrustedFunction(isNVMcleanupFinished) alt wait [not CLEANUP_FINISHED] delay (OsAlarm) APPLICATION_TERMINATED alt Restart [Restart] [Terminate] CallTrustedFunction(Init_IO) Re-initialization of the BSW resources for the considered Partition. CallTrustedFunction(Init_NVM) loop Polling [not REINIT_FINISHED] CallTrustedFunction(IsNvmReInitFinished) alt wait [not REINIT_FINISHED] delay (OsAlarm) Rte_RestartPartition_<Partition> AllowAccess TerminateTask TerminateApplication(<self>, NO_RESTART) Figure 4: Sequence diagram showing the interactions when terminating or restarting a partition.
